name: Lake Washington DPV Planner
short: Plan the route. Know the distance.
description: A planning tool for connecting Lake Washington wrecks and laying out scooter routes before getting in the water.
body: Map the route between wrecks, place waypoints, and work through distances and bearings. This is where route planning meets the practical questions of a DPV dive.
note: Use alongside current site information, your own gas and bailout planning, and independent navigation. A planned route is not a guarantee of underwater position.

name: Dive Current
description: A tides and currents project with bathymetry and DPV route planning.
body: An ongoing software project. Current-data coverage and flow visualization are still being worked on. Check the project notes for limitations before relying on any output.
note: Charts, positions, forecasts, and planning outputs may be incomplete, inaccurate, or out of date. Use official information and independent planning.

name: RunTime Gas Label Studio
short: From the fill station to the cylinder.
description: Cylinder gas labels for nitrox and trimix, with a clear mix and MOD layout and Zebra label printing.
body: Built around the fill-station workflow: select the gas, choose the layout, preview the label, and print. Development updates and printing notes belong here as the tool evolves.
note: Analyze every cylinder and verify the label against its actual contents. A printed label does not verify a gas mix.

name: Innerspace Scuba Society
description: A private home for dive groups, bringing planning, people, and shared information together.
body: Innerspace brings dive-group organization into one place. RunTime connects visitors to the platform and provides a place to follow its development.
note: Pilot-stage platform. Features and access can change as testing continues.
